question: CalPure Foods avocado oil manufacturer origin
markdown:
CalPure Foods
is an American avocado oil manufacturer
founded by multi-generational California vegetable farmers Michael and Erika Rutledge
. The company is headquartered and processes its oil in Southern California, utilizing locally grown Hass avocados alongside select partner farms globally.
